limits: The candidate record documents the final artifact set rebuilt by the release gate at ac94b63 and the earlier local rehearsal at 9b1bef5; rebuilding at the record head changes only record text, but the tag must be built at the final merged head and its hashes re-verified.
Windows results come from GitHub Actions, not a local Windows host; Linux was executed locally.
Firefox and Safari static-subresource behaviour (Sec-Fetch-Mode) remains unverified; only Chromium was exercised.
The local read API HEAD performs one read without consuming the 10-second refresh budget, and a bootstrap token is single-use; sessions expire without a restart command.

The legacy learn_assistant.core.prepare_submission still writes an unencrypted local preview JSON containing a local path; it never uploads or submits and is retained as a v0.1 compatibility boundary.
The wheel does not ship node_modules; gateway-backed capabilities report GATEWAY_EXITED until the documented npm ci step runs.
Real campus login, writes, payments, submissions and model image transfers remain unverified; engineering checks do not raise their evidence level.

The final artifact set was rebuilt by the release gate at 2bd42cc, the commit that includes the consent-peek fix; later record-only commits change plans/ text only, and the tag build must rebuild at the final merged head and re-verify the hashes.
rollback: Restore the five code paths (local-read-api.schema.json, local_api/contract.py, local_api/samples.py, tests/test_local_api.py and the actions.py docstring) to 8d0606d; /todos, /calendar and /resources then depend on the 6.2 QUERY_EXTENSION and its PENDING_CONTRACT_OWNER_REVISION status returns. Delete the 8.1 records and handoff, and restore the ledgers (batch gate, ownership, acceptance map, VERSION_MANIFEST, progress and version lists) to the batch-7 state. The rollback does not touch user state, keys, sessions, downloads or pending transactions, and the candidate dist directory can be deleted because it is not committed.
next: Codex reviews the candidate on version PR #2, requests fixes on the same branch if needed, then merges main, tags v0.2.0, publishes the Release and verifies the downloads. Hermes does not merge, tag or publish in this phase.
